t: You're looking at Hammersmith Library, a public library on Shepherd's Bush Road in Hammersmith. The building is Grade II listed. It was designed by Henry Hare, a British architect who was born in Scarborough in Yorkshire and educated in Sheffield and Harrogate. He lived from eighteen sixty or sixty-one until nineteen twenty-one. I don't have more detail about the library's history, so take a moment to look at the facade and the way it fronts the street.
